dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you... I was just looking through the various commissions that have come in to the Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: But honestly, they're getting more mundane by the day.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Ever since the Qixing have taken control of Liyue Harbor, the scope of the Millelith's duties has been expanding slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Lately, people seem to prefer approaching the Millelith to help out with tougher commissions, as opposed to asking us.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: The commissions we've got now are all things like looking for lost animals, transporting cargo, delivering letters— you know, the like.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: "Our Ash's gotten lost out in the wild. It's a <color=#00E1FFFF>gray cat</color> with the following features..."

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Commissions such as these take time and effort, but they're... Never mind.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: I'm not one to be overly involved in day to day administration of the Guild, but I can't just let us be swamped by these commissions.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: In order to get people to trust in our ability and assign us more important work...

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: ...I believe that we must hammer out some commissions of greater difficulty.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: There was a commission that came in not long ago from someone who wanted us to deal with a wandering Stonehide Lawachurl.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: It's been shelved for the moment due to a lack of candidates who can take that creature down, but if you're up for it, why don't you help us settle this matter?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Great. We're counting on you, then — I'll remain here and continue selecting commissions.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: If we had more adventurers as capable as you around, we wouldn't have this problem...

choices.text: Do you have any other commissions?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: I do, but those are all a bunch of trivial, menial tasks, all of which I still have to sort through. We'll just have to leave the Stonehide Lawachurl to you.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: If we had more adventurers as capable as you around, we wouldn't have this problem...
